explanation: The owl was the bird of Athena, Greek goddess of wisdom, and appeared on ancient Athens' silver coins. Greece's one-euro coin, issued from 2002, copies that owl.

claims.text: In European tradition, the owl is a symbol of wisdom.
The eagle, peacock and swan are not the traditional European symbol of wisdom.
The owl was associated with Athena, the Greek goddess of wisdom.
Silver coins of ancient Athens showed an owl.
Greece's one-euro coin, issued from 2002, shows an owl copied from an ancient Athenian coin.
